C1660.title: Unauthorized Access to E-Commerce Platform Store Revenue Data
C1660.summary: An e-commerce platform provided revenue charts for its hosted shops. An attacker discovered that the API endpoint pattern was /shops/{shopName}/revenue_data.json and used another API to obtain a list of all shop names. By scripting bulk replacement of the shop name in the URL, the attacker accessed sales data for thousands of stores without authorization, representing a classic case of object-leve

references.title: API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization - OWASP API Security
